Naomi Evans is the Major of the Army of the Space Federation and a member of the New Solar born on Titan. Also, she is Assistant Investigators in the Army Military Police Investigation Department.

Naomi is one of the two heroines of Prison Battleship.

Personality
She has a bad habit of hitting criminals who gave up and can be very violent. She is far more hot-headed than her colleague Rieri Bishop and will often listen to whatever Rieri wants. As she views herself as yet too inexperienced, she dislikes the Neo Terra and believes in the superiority of New Solars.

After the destruction of her old personality, she remains mostly the same, but is 100% loyal to Donny Bohgan. She is not able to control her lust for him well and will ask for sex frequently.

Additionally, she gets very jealous and needy at times. Wishing to get more attention.

Appearance
She has black sometimes green hair, her eyes are red.

History
Background
A member of the Space Federation aligned with the New Solar faction. She was born on Saturn's terraformed moon Titan. Originally, she was the eldest daughter of the mercantile house associating with House Bishop, but because of her time spent with her childhood friend Rieri, Naomi chose the path of military personnel in the footsteps of Rieri. She went to the same government military school as her friend. Rieri has become more than just Naomi's senior officer, as the two think of each other as sisters. After helping Rieri to protect her father from a kidnapping, she became the target of Donny Bohgan.

Visual Novels
She and Naomi tried to investigate the Battleship Jasant, by pretending to take down Neo Terra criminals on earth but fell into Bohgan's trap instead. On the 7-day trip, from Titan Station to Earth Space Station, she was knocked out with sleeping gas and put into a Brainwashing Machine, her body was modified. However, she would not remember at daytime, only becoming a slave to Bohgan in the night. Overcame, the VIP Transport Mission and in fact imprisoned Donny Bohgan before her mind was fully gone. However, as the effect lingered, she confronted Donny in his holding cells, which finished the brainwashing and forced Naomi and Rieri to help him escape.

After her training was finished and her old personality was deleted, she became loyal Bohgan. During Prison Battleship 2, she is mentioned, but her fate is unknown as only Rieri appears in the game and did not confirm the situation with her fully toward Alicia Viewstroem.

It is later revealed that, her old personality would return in Prison Battleship 3 while on a mission on Mars. Something, thought to be impossible at first. Though her memory was restored, she was convinced by Bohgan to become his pawn for Rieri Bishop life, as Rieri was ready to die on the spot if she opposed Donny directly. She would save Bohgan's live against Beatrice Kushan and Kila Kushan during a final confrontation. Naomi would have sex with Bohgan once more, this time more as a result of the body modification and less brainwashing, with her still willing to look for a way to save Rieri.

Timeline TABA
In a "what if" event, transported by a spacetime anomaly to the past, she is captured by a criminal group. Which tries to gather information but does not believe her story and continues their torture methods.

Timeline RPGX
Not mentioned but since the Prison Universe visited by Fuuma Kotaro, contains Donny Bohgan already disguised as Cordelia, she is probably captured.

Additional Material
Unlike in the game, where she does reveal that she remembers Bohgan's voice, which is why she investigates the ship so much. In the OVA, she and Rieri both have forgotten him completely. As Bohgan is much more driven by revenge, he takes this personally. The OVA also follows the Good Ending and not the True Ending.
Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Interface for Drones

Gun Turtle: User of a Gun Turtle. Unlike others that are only able to use 1, she can use up to 5 which is a record.
Hand-to-hand combat: She can attack her opponents with high kicks when forced to do battle with them.
Cloak:Able to turn invisible with technology.
Sex Slave/Toy: She and Rieri were modified to be perfect sex slave/toys.
